enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe. Remain still. Snore lightly. Move arm. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over the side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and checking shift notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place stethoscope inside. Place notebook inside. Zip work bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open shift notes app. Read notes. Lock phone. Place phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at hospital stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working morning shift at the hospital, providing patient care and recording observations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient list. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record reading. Adjust IV drip. Walk to patient room 2. Knock. Enter. Assist patient with medication. Record medication time. Walk to nurse station. Update chart. Answer phone. Take message. Walk to patient room 3. Change dressing. Dispose of old dressing. Wash hands. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select sandwich. Select fruit. Pay at cashier. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working afternoon shift at the hospital, attending to patients and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room 1. Check patient status. Administer medication. Record in chart. Walk to patient room 2. Assist with mobility. Walk to nurse station. Update clinical notes on computer. Answer call button. Walk to patient room 3. Reposition patient. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to patient room 4. Take vital signs. Record. Walk to nurse station. Review notes. Consult with colleague.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Arrive at home stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cupboard. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Cross legs. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and drying off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and light chores
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Browse news. Check email. Reply to email. Open social media. Scroll feed. Close browser. Open document. Type notes. Save document. Close computer. Stand up. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Put away vacuum.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the TV on and setting an alarm on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom TV. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 06:30. Close app. Place phone on nightstand. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Return to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe. Remain still. Snore lightly. Move arm. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
